title: Gyudon (Japanese Beef Rice Bowl)
summary: Thinly sliced beef and onions simmered in a lightly sweet soy-dashi sauce and spooned over rice.

steps.description: Thinly slice onion into 5mm strips and slice 10g ginger. Separate any clumps of beef.
Combine 150ml water, 2 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp mirin, 2 tsp sugar, 1/2 tsp dashi powder and ginger in a saucepan; bring to a simmer.
Add onion and simmer over medium heat for 5 minutes until translucent.
Add 250g beef a few slices at a time and simmer 4–6 minutes until fully cooked. Skim foam and add a splash of water if the sauce reduces too much.
Divide warm rice between two bowls, top with beef and onion, and spoon over the remaining sauce to taste.
